Direction from Jack Heart (2026-11-23): "not clear to me we need to support sqlite but also not sure it costs much to do so". In concept-review, explicitly weigh the real cost of supporting both SQLite and Postgres with hand-written SQL + Alembic versus Postgres-only (while still keeping storage backend and push/pull ingestion conceptually orthogonal).
